description: Lightweight FVP vertical-slice gene metrics with MGI-backed alias resolution.

metric_contract.mean_expression_positive: mean Seurat LogNormalize expression among raw-count-positive eligible cells

global_rules: No cells are silently dropped from whole-dataset denominators because annotations are blank.
Blank hypomap_region cells are retained and reported; they are not eligible for named selected-nucleus metrics.
Blank sample_id cells are retained and reported; they are excluded only from scopes requiring sample identity.
